[package]
name = "termoak-ai"
description = "Termoak AI engine: multi-provider (Claude, OpenAI, Codex, OpenCode Go, local), agent with SSH tools, background tasks and MCP"
version = "0.6.0"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.89"
authors = ["Oihalitz <oihalitz@ohz.es>"]
repository = "https://github.com/TermoakSSH/core"
publish = false

[dependencies]
futures = "0.3"
bytes = "1"
async-trait = "0.1"
serde_json = "1"
thiserror = "2"
tracing = "0.1"
url = "2"
parking_lot = "0.12"
base64 = "0.22"
[dependencies.termoak-core]
path = "crates/termoak-core"

[dependencies.termoak-ssh]
path = "crates/termoak-ssh"

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1.53"
features = ["full"]

[dependencies.tokio-util]
version = "0.7"
features = ["io", "codec"]

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.reqwest]
version = "0.12"
default-features = false
features = ["json", "stream", "rustls-tls", "gzip", "http2"]

[dependencies.uuid]
version = "1"
features = ["v4", "v7", "serde"]

[dependencies.chrono]
version = "0.4"
features = ["serde"]

[dependencies.zeroize]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.portable-pty]
version = "0.9"
optional = true

[features]
pty = ["dep:portable-pty"]

[dev-dependencies.axum]
version = "0.8"
features = ["ws", "macros"]

[package]
name = "termoak-client"
description = "Termoak client: server API, sync, remote terminals, relay and local vault"
version = "0.6.0"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.89"
authors = ["Oihalitz <oihalitz@ohz.es>"]
repository = "https://github.com/TermoakSSH/core"
publish = false

[features]
default = ["os-keyring"]
os-keyring = ["dep:keyring"]

[dependencies]
futures = "0.3"
bytes = "1"
serde_json = "1"
thiserror = "2"
tracing = "0.1"
url = "2"
parking_lot = "0.12"
base64 = "0.22"
directories = "6"
[dependencies.termoak-core]
path = "crates/termoak-core"

[dependencies.termoak-ssh]
path = "crates/termoak-ssh"

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1.53"
features = ["full"]

[dependencies.tokio-util]
version = "0.7"
features = ["io", "codec"]

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.reqwest]
version = "0.12"
default-features = false
features = ["json", "stream", "rustls-tls", "gzip", "http2"]

[dependencies.uuid]
version = "1"
features = ["v4", "v7", "serde"]

[dependencies.tokio-tungstenite]
version = "0.28"
features = ["rustls-tls-native-roots", "rustls-tls-webpki-roots"]

[dependencies.zeroize]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.rusqlite]
version = "0.37"
features = ["bundled"]

[dependencies.keyring]
optional = true
version = "3"
features = ["apple-native", "windows-native", "async-secret-service", "crypto-rust", "tokio"]

[dev-dependencies]
tempfile = "3"

[package]
name = "termoak-core"
version = "0.6.0"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.89"
authors = ["Oihalitz <oihalitz@ohz.es>"]
repository = "https://github.com/TermoakSSH/core"
publish = false

[dependencies]
serde_json = "1"
thiserror = "2"
base64 = "0.22"
hex = "0.4"
parking_lot = "0.12"
tracing = "0.1"
chacha20poly1305 = "0.11"
sha2 = "0.11"
sha1 = "0.11"
hmac = "0.13"
data-encoding = "2"
getrandom = "0.4"
[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.uuid]
version = "1"
features = ["v4", "v7", "serde"]

[dependencies.chrono]
version = "0.4"
features = ["serde"]

[dependencies.rusqlite]
version = "0.37"
features = ["bundled"]

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1.53"
features = ["full"]

[dependencies.argon2]
version = "0.6"
features = ["zeroize"]

[dependencies.qrcode]
version = "0.14"
default-features = false

[dependencies.zeroize]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.utoipa]
optional = true
version = "5"
features = ["axum_extras", "chrono", "uuid"]

[features]
default = []
openapi = ["dep:utoipa"]

[dev-dependencies]
tempfile = "3"

[package]
name = "termoak-ssh"
description = "Termoak SSH engine: terminal, exec, SFTP, tunnels, jump hosts and recording; Telnet terminal"
version = "0.6.0"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.89"
authors = ["Oihalitz <oihalitz@ohz.es>"]
repository = "https://github.com/TermoakSSH/core"
publish = false

[dependencies]
russh-sftp = "3"
base64 = "0.22"
bytes = "1"
futures = "0.3"
async-trait = "0.1"
thiserror = "2"
tracing = "0.1"
serde_json = "1"
parking_lot = "0.12"
rand = "0.10"
[dependencies.termoak-core]
path = "crates/termoak-core"

[dependencies.russh]
version = "0.63"
default-features = false
features = ["flate2", "ring", "rsa"]

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1.53"
features = ["full"]

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.chrono]
version = "0.4"
features = ["serde"]

[dependencies.zeroize]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dev-dependencies]
tempfile = "3"

[package]
name = "termoak-update"
description = "Signed automatic updates for Termoak (downloaded in the background, applied on restart)"
version = "0.6.0"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.89"
authors = ["Oihalitz <oihalitz@ohz.es>"]
repository = "https://github.com/TermoakSSH/core"
publish = false

[[bin]]
name = "termoak-release"
path = "src/bin/release.rs"

[dependencies]
futures = "0.3"
serde_json = "1"
thiserror = "2"
tracing = "0.1"
base64 = "0.22"
hex = "0.4"
ed25519-dalek = "2"
semver = "1"
self-replace = "1"
flate2 = "1"
tar = "0.4"
getrandom = "0.4"
[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1.53"
features = ["full"]

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.reqwest]
version = "0.12"
default-features = false
features = ["json", "stream", "rustls-tls", "gzip", "http2"]

[dependencies.sha2-10]
package = "sha2"
version = "0.10"

[dependencies.clap]
version = "4"
features = ["derive", "env"]

[dependencies.chrono]
version = "0.4"
features = ["serde"]

[dev-dependencies]
tempfile = "3"

[dev-dependencies.axum]
version = "0.8"
features = ["ws", "macros"]
